hypothesis: Quality-at-a-reasonable-price (QARP). value cheapness × quality 우량 conditional/interaction 결합으로 cheap-junk(value trap) 회피 + expensive-quality 회피. value premium은 quality 통제 시 강화 (Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen 2019 QMJ + Piotroski 2000).

factor_specs.economic_rationale: profitable firms compound; QMJ profitability leg (Asness 2019)
low default risk = QMJ safety leg; value trap 제거

quality_axis_overlap_note: Q07_Earnings_Stability / Q25_Ohlson_O EXCLUDED — STR_1715 already uses them. residual signal cor(s_quality, 1715)=0.001, cor(s_value, 1715)=-0.032 → 직교 매우 양호.

signal_family_diagnostics_lockbox.note: All 240 lockbox months (<=2023-12-22). rank-IC = Spearman(signal, fwd 1M return). authoritative.

s_interact_multiplicative.honest_finding: ★ pure multiplicative product = NOISE. Only conditional double-sort form (s_cond) works. AX-000 정직 보고.

interaction_beats_marginal.criterion: ICIR(interaction) > ICIR(marginal sum) AND SR_net_lb(interaction) > SR_net_lb(marginal). 둘 다 충족.
interaction_beats_marginal.critical_caveat: interaction_beats_marginal=TRUE는 conditional double-sort(s_cond) 형태에서만 성립. 단순 multiplicative product(s_interact)는 ICIR 0.007로 무의미. 즉 'value×quality 상호작용'은 FUNCTIONAL FORM 의존적 — 비선형 gating(QARP)이 본질, 곱셈 항 자체가 아님.

diagnostics.subperiod_note: all 3 subperiods (2008-14/2015-19/2020-26) same sign as full

portfolio_diagnostics.basis: s_cond top-25 long-only EW, net 15bps one-way (buy+sell legs)
portfolio_diagnostics.portfolio_alpha_t_note: ★ portfolio-alpha t (active net vs universe EW) != rank-IC t (6.33). Judge는 forge 5-spec portfolio-alpha t를 authoritative로 채택 (Cycle 2 교훈).
portfolio_diagnostics.dsr_honest_n_trials_caveat: DSR formula n_tests=17 (within-track). cross-cycle 누적 trial ~19 (52WHIGH/BAB/BAC/DISPERSION/.../VALUE/ACCRUAL/TECHNICAL/QVALUE) 인지 시 DSR 천장은 단일-alpha 한계로 여전히 net SR ~0.3 binding (Cycle 2 교훈). DSR=1.0은 within-track multi-form 보정만 반영 — single-alpha deployment 시 multi-sleeve 전제 필수.

orthogonality.interpretation: ★ signal cor 0.006 (near-perfectly orthogonal in signal space) 이지만 realized return cor 0.778 (높음). KR long-only 구조적 한계 — 신호 직교 ≠ 수익률 직교 (BAB/VALUE track 교훈 재확인). 단 standalone 강도(net SR 0.92, pa_t 3.75)와 DPL 피처 가치(s_cond는 비선형 QARP gating feature)로 평가 시 가치 있음.

ax001_v2.basis: REALIZED active return in bottom-20% benchmark months. IC bad>normal>good monotone — quality safety leg가 위기에서 강화.

economic_rationale: Quality-at-a-reasonable-price (QARP). KR value premium은 quality 통제 시 강화 (Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen 2019 QMJ; Piotroski 2000 value-stock fundamental selection). cheap-AND-good (low BM/EP × high ROIC/GP/Altman-Z) 종목이 cheap-junk(저평가 부실) 대비 우월 mean-revert. 비선형 conditional gating으로 value trap 제거 + 비싼 우량 배제. STR_1715 forward consensus-revision과 메커니즘 직교 (signal cor 0.006), quality axis는 Q07/Q25 제외로 overlap 최소화.

axiom_compliance.AX_003: EP NOT standalone — value is 4-proxy axis inside conditional interaction
axiom_compliance.AX_004: quality NOT single — profitability(4) + safety(4) multi-axis
axiom_compliance.AX_002: PIT lockbox 2023-12-22 strict; graduation metrics on lockbox window only
axiom_compliance.AX_000: 입증된 한계 정직 보고 — s_interact NOISE + realized return cor 0.778 high 그대로 보고
axiom_compliance.AX_001_v2: 조건부 평가 — bad/normal IC ratio 1.90 + realized crisis_alpha 양수

verdict: STRONG_STANDALONE — interaction_beats_marginal TRUE (conditional form only). graduation 5/5 PASS. DPL 피처 가치 + standalone 강도 모두 충족. 단 realized return cor vs 1715=0.778 (수익률 직교 약함) → diversifier 아닌 강한 standalone/DPL 피처로 채택.

challenge_flags.note: realized return cor vs STR_1715 = 0.778 (high). signal 직교에도 long-only 수익률 직교 약함 — diversifier 가치 제한. standalone/DPL로만 가치.
s_interact(multiplicative) ICIR 0.007 = noise. interaction은 functional-form 의존 (conditional gating만 작동). spec robustness 제한.
DSR=1.0은 within-track 보정. cross-cycle ~19 trials 인지 시 single-alpha SR 천장 여전 (multi-sleeve 전제).
